visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor home setting. A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a dark t-shirt sits at a white table, resting his chin on his palm with a look of extreme indecision. Two mugs, one speckled and one plain cream, sit before him. A large leafy green plant stands in the background by a window. (2) He stands in front of a mirror holding a teal t-shirt and a brown t-shirt on hangers, rotating them as he struggles to decide what to wear. (3) He is seen sitting on a blue sofa, hunched over and staring intensely at a smartphone. (4) A close-up shot shows his hands holding the smartphone, playing a mobile game with anime-style characters. (5) He sits on a wooden chair against a white wall decorated with printed pictures of laptops. He has the teal and brown t-shirts draped over his shoulders simultaneously. He grabs his hair and shouts in frustration. (6) A bright, divine light effect glows over his head, and he looks up with wide eyes and a shocked expression. (7) He returns to his phone, scrolling through a website. (8) Screen recordings of the 'huahuacomputer.com.tw' website appear, displaying various laptop models and promotional banners. (9) He holds his phone toward the camera, pointing at the laptop website with a smile, still wearing the two shirts on his shoulders. (10) A fast montage of website pages follows, showing text about customization, RAM, and SSD options. (11) He is seen in a new setup, sitting at a desk with a laptop, headset, and speakers, hugging a large plush pillow with a cartoon face. (12) He stands by a wooden door and receives a brown cardboard shipping box from an off-screen person, reacting with exaggerated surprise. (13) More website screenshots detail warranty information, 36-month installment plans, and LINE customer service. (14) He holds up a sleek gray laptop to the camera, showcasing its design. (15) Brief clips show various lifestyles: a person playing with a game controller in neon light, a student in a library, and a businessman in a suit. (16) He demonstrates the checkout process on his phone, typing the code 'sirenia' into a promotional code field. (17) A product graphic of a six-fan laptop cooling pad is displayed. (18) The video ends with him standing confidently in his room, holding his phone and looking satisfied.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, fast-paced electronic pop BGM. A male voice speaks with exaggerated comic distress, describing someone named Manatee with severe 'choice paralysis.' (2) The BGM cuts out for a split second as a soft female voice asks a question. This is immediately followed by the male speaker letting out a loud, high-pitched comedic scream SFX. (3) A magical chime and 'divine' orchestral stinger sound as a light effect is introduced. The speaker's tone shifts from distressed to shocked and then quickly into a high-energy, authoritative promotional tone. (4) The electronic BGM resumes at a steady, driving tempo. The speaker begins a rapid-fire delivery of brand benefits, punctuated by sharp 'whoosh' sounds for visual transitions and 'pop' SFX for text overlays. (5) Audible clicks and digital UI sounds appear during the screen recording sections. The narrator maintains a high arousal level, speaking clearly and enthusiastically about customization, installments, and discounts. (6) A final 'ding' sound and a rhythmic swell in the BGM lead to the concluding statement, where the speaker's voice is confident and inviting.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Solution -> Proof -> CTA. The video starts with a humorous portrayal of the 'choice paralysis' problem before revealing the brand 'Hua Hua Computer' as the ultimate solution, followed by a list of technical benefits and a discount offer.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for 'Hua Hua Computer' (驊哥電腦), a service specializing in customized laptops and peripherals. It uses the character 'Manatee' and his 'choice paralysis' as a relatable hook to explain how the company simplifies the complex process of choosing computer hardware through expert customization, flexible payment, and comprehensive warranty services.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video contains a direct brand introduction, detailed service features, a specific call-to-action (CTA) to visit the website, and a promotional discount code 'sirenia'.
